cafe.notes_base: Rating 4.6 (Gaode). Verified via RedNote: 3269 likes in a Qianmen cafe roundup post. Japanese courtyard aesthetics — wooden furniture, green plants, blue tiles in a Ming-era hutong alley. Independent, non-chain, aesthetically distinctive. Yangmeichu Xiejie listed as 2025 Beijing trending landmark. Opens 10:00. Perfect mid-morning stop after breakfast while exploring Dashilar. CNY 48/person.
cafe.notes_local: 评分4.6（高德）。小红书验证：3269赞，前门最美咖啡店合集强推。日式小庭院风，原木桌椅+青砖绿植，杨梅竹斜街明代胡同，2025年北京新晋网红打卡地。10:00开门，早餐后胡同散步时顺路喝一杯，人均48元。
